div.div: Web token: single use, valid 60 s, bound to the same user, issued only to the webgate's uid and accepted only from guacd's real address. The broker skips privacyIDEA because MFA was proven at Keycloak. No H.264 in the browser path; sessions get no Kerberos ticket.
